notes.title: Version 1.5 released
notes.notes: The script of the game has been entirely revised. More than a third of the text has either been edited, added, or removed. The core of the story remains the same, but some scenes have a different vibe, and the quality of the writing has been improved.

notes.title: Version 1.1 released
